description: This file defines a React functional component 'ChangeEditorMenu' for rendering a menu to change editor components or note types within a web application. It manages state, handles user interactions, and integrates with application services for note editing features.

classes.name: ChangeEditorMenu
classes.description: React functional component for rendering a menu to change editor components or note types.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Generates a group ID string from an EditorMenuGroup by converting the title to lowercase and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item is currently selected based on the current component or note type.

methods.name: selectComponent
methods.description: Handles selecting a specific editor component for a note, updating the note's type and editor identifier.

methods.name: selectNonComponent
methods.description: Handles selecting a non-component note type, updating the note's type and editor identifier accordingly.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Main handler for selecting a menu item, managing permissions, conflicts, and triggering appropriate actions.

methods.name: handleSuperNoteConversionCompletion
methods.description: Handles completion of super note conversion, updating the note accordingly.

methods.name: closeSuperNoteImporter
methods.description: Closes the super note importer modal.
